title: Running Commentary on Torah 52 — Ha'Ne'or Ba'Laylah
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 52 — הנעור בלילה
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **"Rabbi Chanina ben Chachinai omer: **'ha'ne'or ba'laylah, v'ha'm'haleich ba'derech yechidi, u'mpaneh libo l'vatalah — harei zeh mis'chayev b'nafsho'"** (Avos 3:4). 'One awake at night, walking alone on the road, emptying his heart to idleness — is guilty against his own soul.'

intermediate.en: **Avos 3:4** (R" Chanina ben Chachinai): ne'or ba'laylah + m'haleich ba'derech yechidi + m'paneh libo l'vatalah = mis'chayev b'nafsho.
intermediate.he: **אבות ג, ד** (ר"ח בן חכינאי): נעור בלילה + מהלך בדרך יחידי + מפנה ליבו לבטלה = מתחייב בנפשו.

beginner.en: **"α. There are **apikorsim** who say the world is **mechuyav ha'metzi'us** (necessary existence). Their corrupt da'as thinks there are 'proofs' from world's conduct. But **'hevel yifzeh pihem'** — truly the world is **efshar ha'metzi'us** (possible existence). Only Hashem is mechuyav ha'metzi'us; all worlds + everything in them are efshar. He created them yesh mei'ayin, and had the power to create them or not."**

intermediate.en: **α. Apikorsim: world=mechuyav ha'metzi'us (heretical)**. Truth: world=**efshar ha'metzi'us**; only Hashem=mechuyav. Yesh mei'ayin; could have not created.
intermediate.he: **α. אפיקורסים: עולם=מחויב המציאות (כפירה)**. אמת: עולם=**אפשר המציאות**; רק ה'=מחויב. יש מאין; יכל שלא לברוא.

beginner.en: **"β. Ikkar kavanah of creation: for Yisrael to do His ratzon and **return + cleave to their root** — included in Him, the Mechuyav ha'Metzi'us. Thus when Yisrael do His ratzon and are nichlal b'shorsham (=mechuyav), **the whole world nichlal in mechuyav ha'metzi'us via them**. Because the ikkar tachlis was bi'shvilam, Hashem **mechuyav**, k'viyachol, to create and sustain all worlds for Israel's sake."**

intermediate.en: **β. Creation for Yisrael**. Yisrael do ratzon → nichlal b'shoresh (mechuyav) → whole world via them included in mechuyav. Hashem k'viyachol mechuyav to create/sustain for them.
intermediate.he: **β. בריאה לישראל**. ישראל עושים רצון → נכללים בשורש (מחויב) → כל העולם דרכם במחויב. ה' כביכול מחויב לברוא/לקיים בשבילם.

beginner.en: **"And now see wonder of wonders — how all this is clearly explained in the Mishnah**:

intermediate.en: Now the peirush of the mishnah:

beginner.en: **"**'Ha'ne'or ba'laylah'** — pshat: one awake at night, **misbodeid and pours forth his conversation beino l'bein kono**. **'V'ha'm'haleich ba'derech yechidi'** — as above: he walks on a **solitary road** (where others don't travel) — there is the ikar shleimus ha'hisbodedus, **ba'laylah + ba'derech yechidi dayka** — for **then precisely can one reach bitul**. **'U'mpaneh libo l'vatalah'** = empties his heart **from all olam hazeh** for **bitul**. Then he merits that his **nefesh be nichlal b'mechuyav ha'metzi'us** (binclusion into the One). And through him, **all worlds are nichlal in Him** — one who attains this, **gives chiyus to all worlds**."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Peirush mishnah**: **ne'or ba'laylah**=hisbodedus; **derech yechidi dayka**=solitary place (ikar shleimus); **m'paneh libo l'vatalah**=emptying for bitul → nefesh nichlal b'mechuyav → all worlds via him.
intermediate.he: **γ. פירוש המשנה**: **נעור בלילה**=התבודדות; **דרך יחידי דייקא**=מקום בודד (עיקר שלמות); **מפנה ליבו לבטלה**=ריקון לבטול → נפש נכללת במחויב → כל העולמות דרכו.

beginner.en: **R"N note**: **"Here is Rabbeinu's own language on this Torah in its extremely concise form, and this is it:"**

intermediate.en: R"N: Rabbeinu's own language follows in concise form.

beginner.en: **"**'Ha'm'haleich ba'derech yechidi, ha'ne'or ba'laylah'** — know: **ikkar ha'bitul** (nullifying ishus, becoming ayin, included in Hashem's Oneness) is only via **hisbodedus**. Hisbodedus needs **specific place+time** — no distracting mani'os. **Time=laylah** (**ha'ne'or ba'laylah**) — when all sleep. **Place=derech yechidi, not ba'derech ha'rabim**, so passersby don't interrupt; **dayka** in a path where crowds don't go — there he goes and misbodeid. Then he can **empty his lev** from everything..."**

intermediate.en: **Ikkar bitul via hisbodedus** — needs **laylah (sleep time) + derech yechidi (no passersby)** → empty lev → bitul.
intermediate.he: **עיקר בטול בהתבודדות** — דרוש **לילה (זמן שינה) + דרך יחידי (אין עוברים)** → ריקון לב → בטול.
